description.zh: 上传附件成功后返回的附件Key，可通过调用接口[GetUserUploadFileJob](~~206069~~)获取该参数的值。
description.en: The key of an attachment that is returned after the attachment is uploaded. You can call the [GetUserUploadFileJob](~~206069~~) operation to query the key of the attachment.
The description of the ticket to be created.

description.zh: 创建工单参数，格式为JSON形式的字符串。每个工单类型的参数设置不一致，详情请参见表格下方的**PluginParam参数补充说明**。
description.en: The ticket creation parameter. The value is a JSON string. The value of this parameter differs based on the type of the ticket. For more information, see the **PluginParam parameter** section in this topic.

description.zh: 工单类型，取值请参见[PluginType参数说明](~~429109~~)。
description.en: The type of the ticket. For more information, see [PluginType parameter](~~429109~~).

description.zh: 工单相关人用户ID列表，多个相关人用半角逗号（,）隔开。
description.en: The IDs of the stakeholders that are involved in the ticket. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

description.zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口[GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~)或[ListUserTenants](~~198074~~)获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the [GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~) or [ListUserTenants](~~198074~~) operation to obtain the tenant ID.

descriptions.zh:
为了降低创建工单的难度，如果您需要创建以下类型的工单，请调用专用接口创建。
- 普通数据变更工单：调用[CreateDataCorrectOrder](~~208388~~)接口。
- 历史数据清理工单：调用[CreateDataCronClearOrder](~~208385~~)接口。
- 数据导入工单：调用[CreateDataImportOrder](~~208387~~)接口。
- 无锁变更工单：调用[CreateFreeLockCorrectOrder](~~208386~~)接口。
descriptions.en:
To simplify ticket creation, if you need to create tickets of the following types, invoke the dedicated API instead:
- Standard Data Updated At ticket: invoke the [CreateDataCorrectOrder](~~208388~~) API.
- Historical Data cleanup ticket: invoke the [CreateDataCronClearOrder](~~208385~~) API.
- Data Import ticket: invoke the [CreateDataImportOrder](~~208387~~) API.
- Lockless change ticket: invoke the [CreateFreeLockCorrectOrder](~~208386~~) API.
